articles.title: France riots latest - curfews imposed in Paris and other cities after days of violent disorder
articles.titleZh: 法国最近发生骚乱-巴黎和其他城市在几天的暴力骚乱后实施宵禁
articles.summary:
French police have imposed curfews in cities across the country, after days of violent disorder, with shops looted and buildings set on fire. 

In parts of central Paris, people will be banned from the streets between 2300 and 0600.   In Nice the curfew applies only  to young people.  There are also restrictions in Lyon and Lille and Marseille.

The Prime Minister French PM Sébastien Lecornu gave local authorities the power to impose the curfews after days of rioting, with thousands of arrests.  In a statement, he said: "We will not be dictated and ruled by the breakers, by the thieves, by the thugs".

The disorder began last month with students protesting over school conditions but has escalated to take in a wide range of grievances. Lecornu claimed the movement was being led by what he called “ultra-Left radical groups” who he said were hoping to "create chaos" ahead of next year’s French presidential election.  More than half a million people took to the streets at the weekend to protest against his government and its policies. 

France’s neighbours in Europe are watching events with concern. Many of them, including Italy, Spain, Belgium, Portugal and Albania are seeing their own domestic protests, driven in large part by public anger over price increases and the rising cost of living. 

Fiona Bruce presents BBC News at Ten reporting by Katya Adler, Nick Beake and Nick Thorpe. 

Subscribe to our channel here: https://bbc.in/bbcnews

For the latest news download the BBC News app or visit BBC.com/news

articles.readingTextZh:
在几天的暴力骚乱之后，法国警方在全国各地的城市实施宵禁，商店被洗劫一空，建筑物被烧毁。

在巴黎市中心的部分地区，人们将在2300至0600之间被禁止上街。

在尼斯，宵禁仅适用于年轻人。

里昂、里尔和马赛也有限制。

法国总理塞巴斯蒂安·勒科尔努（ Sébastien Lecornu ）在数天的骚乱后赋予地方当局实施宵禁的权力，并逮捕了数千人。

他在一份声明中说： “我们不会受到破坏者、小偷和暴徒的指挥和统治。”

这种疾病始于上个月，当时学生抗议学校的条件，但已经升级为接受广泛的不满。

勒科努声称，这场运动是由他所谓的“极左激进组织”领导的，他说他们希望在明年法国总统大选之前“制造混乱”。

周末，超过50万人走上街头抗议他的政府及其政策。

法国在欧洲的邻国正在关注这些事件。

包括意大利、西班牙、比利时、葡萄牙和阿尔巴尼亚在内的许多国家正在发生自己的国内抗议活动，这在很大程度上是由于公众对价格上涨和生活成本上升的愤怒。

菲奥娜·布鲁斯（ Fiona Bruce ）主持了由卡蒂亚·阿德勒（ Katya Adler ）、尼克·比克（ Nick Beake ）

articles.title: Could Latino voters cost Trump and Republicans Congress?
articles.titleZh: 拉丁裔选民会让特朗普和共和党国会付出代价吗？
articles.summary:
Latinos have emerged in recent years as perhaps the biggest group of swing voters in the United States. And if results next month mirror polls that suggest the nation’s 36 million Latino voters are shifting in significant numbers in Democrats’ favor, those voters could be responsible for handing the party control of Congress for the final two years of Trump’s presidency.
Traditionally a Democratic-leaning portion of the electorate in most of the nation, Latinos swung heavily toward Trump in the 2024 election — igniting Republican dreams of a long-term political realignment that could remake the American political map, particularly across the growing South.
But the economic frustrations that helped propel Trump to victory are now fueling dissatisfaction among many of those same voters with Republicans who fully control the federal government.

articles.readingText:
Latinos have emerged in recent years as perhaps the biggest group of swing voters in the United States.

And if results next month mirror polls that suggest the nation’s 36 million Latino voters are shifting in significant numbers in Democrats’ favor, those voters could be responsible for handing the party control of Congress for the final two years of Trump’s presidency.

Traditionally a Democratic-leaning portion of the electorate in most of the nation, Latinos swung heavily toward Trump in the 2024 election — igniting Republican dreams of a long-term political realignment that could remake the American political map, particularly across the growing South.

But the economic frustrations that helped propel Trump to victory are now fueling dissatisfaction among many of those same voters with Republicans who fully control the federal government.
articles.readingTextZh:
近年来，拉美裔可能成为美国最大的摇摆选民群体。

如果下个月的民意调查结果显示，全国3600万拉丁裔选民正在大量转向民主党人，那么这些选民可能有责任在特朗普总统任期的最后两年将党对国会的控制权移交给国会。

拉美裔传统上是美国大部分地区的民主党选民，他们在2024年大选中大举转向特朗普，点燃了共和党长期政治重组的梦想，这可能会重塑美国的政治版图，特别是在不断增长的南方。

但现在，推动特朗普获胜的经济挫折加剧了许多选民对完全控制联邦政府的共和党人的不满。
